notes: Mullvad VPN's Android client, on Google Play as net.mullvad.mullvadvpn, with a strong and deliberate visual identity. The repository is Rust first: there is no settings.gradle.kts at its root and the Android client is a whole Gradle build under android/ — which is what workingDirectory is for, and this import is the reason that field exists (#23). :lib:ui:designsystem is the pure-Compose design system (MullvadButton, ListItem, Checkbox, Switch, FilterChip, FeatureChip); it is chosen over :lib:ui:component and the feature modules because it is the layer least likely to drag in the daemon, the gRPC bindings or anything built by cargo. Counted in a checkout: 21 @Preview functions in main/kotlin, all catalogued. previewAnnotations names PreviewFontScale, the AndroidX multipreview five of them carry. If the first render still trips over a native or protobuf step, that is the thing to read the log for. Licence: GPL-3.0 — see the note on the pull request.
